title: The Harvest Cup
reward: 4,000g, a recruit and 250 Farm Rank points; the story ends, and the farm goes on
source: CS43, CS40 (the Cup); the scenes outlined here (M6)

scenes.title: An Old Ribbon
outline: The Mayor at the festival ground with the old Cup ribbon from Hilltop Track: the farm last won the Harvest Cup in Old Ben’s day
Old Ben remembers the team that won it, and who ran beside whom
Wren Ashby and Cole Varga have shared the Cup every year since, and say so
A team of three, run by their numbers and their bonds; the Uma you’re closest to asks to run

scenes.title: The Cup Comes Home
outline: Winter 12: your team crosses the line first, and Wren and Cole come to shake hands
Old Ben sets the Cup back on the farm’s mantel
Your newest hand at the Gate
The Mayor: the farm is alive again. The story ends; the farm, the calendar and the festivals go on
